diagnosed_change_only.to: official assets downloaded and hash-verified on the Mac, then transferred to fresh server staging files with resumable SFTP capped at 4096 Kbit/s
diagnosed_change_only.unchanged: uv 0.12.9, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu asset, official URLs, bytes, hashes, archive member policy, Hindsight source and lock identities, scientific roles, and all downstream gates

materializers.role: shared frozen release constants and safe archive extraction
server-side staged-asset verification, extraction, and evidence

transfer_contract.local_acceptance: Both files must match frozen bytes and SHA-256 before any SFTP connection.
transfer_contract.sftp_resume_mode: OpenSSH sftp put -a to the same fresh staging path; append-resume is permitted only after an interrupted connection and before any server-side materialization.
transfer_contract.post_transfer_acceptance: The server must independently match bytes and SHA-256 for both staged files before extraction.

execution_contract.wave1_non_interference: Only bounded download, rate-limited transfer, hashing, extraction, and uv --version are permitted; models, datasets, Python environments, pg0, APIs, and GPUs are inaccessible to this stage.

acceptance: Mac and server copies of both assets independently match the same frozen bytes and hashes.
The recovery materializer revalidates the checksum sidecar content and safe archive membership.
The extracted target contains exactly regular uv and uvx binaries.
The accepted evidence retains its own archive and checksum copy plus all hashes.
The fresh recovery evidence root is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and not TERMINAL_REJECTED.
failure: Any local or remote identity mismatch, exhausted transfer connection budget, collision, unsafe archive member, extraction error, or version mismatch seals the fresh recovery evidence root as TERMINAL_REJECTED and preserves all artifacts.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit recovery1, then export the frozen official uv.lock without changing it. No dependency installation or model acquisition is authorized.
prohibited_actions: editing or deleting the original rejected root
reusing the original target or evidence root
changing release identity or using an installer script
materializing before server-side byte and hash verification
more than three SFTP connections or any non-SFTP Mac-to-server transfer
installing dependencies, downloading models, starting pg0, a service, lifecycle, or numerical run
populating any comparison-table numeric cell from this recovery
